mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_shifts (worker_id, job_id, company_id, shift_date, start_time, end_time, location_name, location_lat, location_lng, location_radius, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{workerId}, #{jobId}, #{companyId}, #{shiftDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{locationName}, #{locationLat}, #{locationLng}, #{locationRadius}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT ss.*, j.title AS job_title, j.location AS job_location FROM schedule_shifts ss LEFT JOIN jobs j ON ss.job_id = j.id WHERE ss.id = #{id}
SELECT ss.*, j.title AS job_title, j.location AS job_location FROM schedule_shifts ss LEFT JOIN jobs j ON ss.job_id = j.id WHERE ss.worker_id = #{workerId}

SELECT ss.*, j.title AS job_title, j.location AS job_location FROM schedule_shifts ss LEFT JOIN jobs j ON ss.job_id = j.id WHERE ss.worker_id = #{workerId} ORDER BY ss.shift_date ASC, ss.start_time ASC LIMIT 6
SELECT ss.*, j.title AS job_title, j.location AS job_location FROM schedule_shifts ss LEFT JOIN jobs j ON ss.job_id = j.id WHERE ss.job_id = #{jobId}

SELECT ss.*, j.title AS job_title, j.location AS job_location FROM schedule_shifts ss LEFT JOIN jobs j ON ss.job_id = j.id WHERE ss.worker_id = #{workerId} AND (ss.shift_date > CURDATE() OR (ss.shift_date = CURDATE() AND ss.start_time > CURTIME())) AND ss.status != 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY ss.shift_date ASC, ss.start_time ASC LIMIT #{size}

SELECT ss.*, j.title AS job_title, j.location AS job_location FROM schedule_shifts ss LEFT JOIN jobs j ON ss.job_id = j.id WHERE ss.worker_id = #{workerId} AND ss.shift_date = CURDATE() AND ss.status != 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY ss.start_time ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule_shifts SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE schedule_shifts SET worker_id = #{workerId}, job_id = #{jobId}, company_id = #{companyId}, shift_date = #{shiftDate}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, location_name = #{locationName}, location_lat = #{locationLat}, location_lng = #{locationLng}, location_radius = #{locationRadius}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
